summary_1line: Kaurava and Pandava champions boast how quickly they could destroy the opposing army, while Arjuna asserts overwhelming power but vows to fight fairly.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma laughs loudly in the Kaurava council as Karna boasts he can destroy the Pandava army in five days.
Arjuna, standing beside Krishna, declares that with Vasudeva as his ally he could destroy the three worlds in a moment.
Yudhishthira privately gathers his brothers to report the spies’ news about the Kaurava generals’ claims of how fast they can annihilate the Pandava army.
